compress_image_jpeg: compress a PyTorch image tensor using JPEG compression with a given quality factor
compress_image_webp: compress a PyTorch image tensor using WebP compression with a given quality factor
apply_median_filter: apply a median filter to a batch of images with a specified odd kernel size
create_difference_image: create a normalized difference image between two PyTorch image tensors
generate_color_palette: generate a fixed color palette with distinct RGB colors for a given number of masks
